description: i18n infrastructure (design §1-§4, §6 component, §10 tests): types, th/en locales for all 8 namespaces (seeded), pure translate/format/labels, useT/t/useUiLanguage/useFormat, persisted languageStore ('pos-language'), LanguageToggle UI component, test-only react-dom ambient decls, and unit tests. No screen changes. Plan item 1.
steps: Create src/i18n/types.ts: Language='th'|'en', LANGUAGES, isLanguage(x), LocaleShape<T>, Leaves<T,P>, TranslationKey=Leaves<typeof th>, UiKey=Exclude<TranslationKey,`receipt.${string}`>, ReceiptKey=Extract<...>, TParams (design §1 code block).

Create src/i18n/locales/th/{common,nav,auth,pos,payment,receipt,receiptScreen,settings}.ts (each `export const X = {...} as const`, camelCase keys, <=3 levels, {name} placeholders) and th/index.ts; create matching src/i18n/locales/en/*.ts each annotated `LocaleShape<typeof thX>` and en/index.ts typed `LocaleShape<typeof th>`. Seed: common.langShort.th|en ('TH'/'EN' both), common.docType.receipt|taxShort|taxFull, common basics (save, cancel, confirm, close, back, loading, error, errorTitle, noData, retry, search); payment.method.{cash,transfer,qr,credit,wallet,ewallet,coupon} th pinned เงินสด/โอน/QR Code/บัตร/Wallet/E-Wallet/คูปอง, en Cash/Transfer/QR Code/Card/Wallet/E-Wallet/Coupon; payment.memberTypeDiscount th 'ส่วนลด{name} {percent}%' en '{name} discount {percent}%'; pos.orderType.<id> for every OrderType in src/types/sale.ts (th wording = ORDER_TYPE_LABELS); nav.role.<id> for every role in WebTopBar ROLE_LABELS; receipt.* full set per design §5.2-§5.4 (thankYou 'ขอบคุณที่ใช้บริการ 🙏'/'Thank you 🙏', headOffice 'สำนักงานใหญ่'/'Head Office', dateTimeValue '{date} {time} น.'/'{date} {time}', cashierFallback แคชเชียร์/Cashier, sampleCashier 'พนักงาน A'/'Staff A', docTitle.receipt|taxShort|taxFull ใบเสร็จรับเงิน/ใบกำกับภาษีอย่างย่อ/ใบกำกับภาษี vs Receipt/Abbreviated Tax Invoice/Tax Invoice, cancelledStamp, captions billNo/date/cashier/paidBy/taxInvoiceNo/issueDate/tel/taxId, orderDetail.readyDate|address|phone|note|table|zone, column headers, subtotal/discount/vat/beforeVat/total/cash/change, keepReceipt); settings.language 'ภาษา / Language', settings.uiLanguage, settings.receiptLanguage 'ภาษาใบเสร็จ / Receipt language', settings.receiptLanguageHint 'ใบกำกับภาษีตามกฎหมายควรออกเป็นภาษาไทย'. Other namespaces may hold only a couple of keys; later FEATs extend them.

Create src/i18n/translate.ts: lookup(dict, path), interpolate(str, params) replacing /\{(\w+)\}/g (missing param stays literal + dev warn), translate(lang, key: TranslationKey, params?) with en->th fallback + dev-only console.warn('[i18n] missing en key', key), unknown key -> key; dev guard `typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' ? __DEV__ : process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` (export a small isDev() for test overriding or read at call time so tests can toggle NODE_ENV).

Create src/i18n/format.ts: DateInput = Date|number|string; formatDate (th dd/MM/(yyyy+543), en dd/MM/yyyy), formatTime HH:mm, formatDateTime, formatNumber(n, lang, decimals=0) manual grouping, formatMoney (฿1,234.50, -฿10.00, NaN/±Inf -> ฿0.00); invalid date -> '-'. No Intl/toLocale*.

Create src/i18n/labels.ts: KnownPayMethod type, PAY_METHOD_KEYS: Record<KnownPayMethod, UiKey>, PAY_ICON (cash cash-outline, qr qr-code-outline, transfer phone-portrait-outline, credit card-outline, wallet/ewallet wallet-outline), payMethodLabel(id, lang, customLabel?) -> known ? translate : customLabel ?? id, ORDER_TYPE_KEYS: Record<OrderType, UiKey>, ROLE_KEYS, DOC_TYPE_KEYS -> common.docType.*, DEFAULT_FOOTER_TH = th.receipt.thankYou, DEFAULT_BRANCH_TH = th.receipt.headOffice. Imports only locales/translate/types (and type-only OrderType).

Create src/store/languageStore.ts: zustand create()(persist(...)) name 'pos-language', version 1, storage createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage), partialize {uiLanguage}, merge normalizes via isLanguage -> 'th'; setUiLanguage ignores invalid (dev warn); on web (typeof document !== 'undefined') set document.documentElement.lang on rehydrate and via subscribe.

Create src/i18n/useT.ts: useT() (subscribes useLanguageStore(s=>s.uiLanguage), useCallback), useUiLanguage(), non-hook t(key: UiKey, params?) reading getState() at call time, useFormat() -> {date,time,dateTime,number,money} bound to UI lang. Create src/i18n/index.ts barrel exporting types, useT/t/useUiLanguage/useFormat, labels — NOT format.ts.
Create src/types/react-dom-test.d.ts with the ambient 'react-dom/client' (createRoot) and 'react-dom/test-utils' (act) declarations from design §10.

Create src/components/ui/LanguageToggle.tsx: controlled TH|EN segmented control, props {value: Language; onChange(l: Language): void; size?: 'md'|'lg'; accessibilityLabel?: string; style?: ViewStyle}, segment minHeight ComponentSize.button.md, tokens only (Colors.primary/white/border, Typography, Spacing, BorderRadius), each segment accessibilityRole='button' + accessibilityState={{selected}}, labels via useT()('common.langShort.th'|'en'). Follow Button.tsx style conventions. Export from src/components/ui/index.ts.

Tests: src/i18n/__tests__/parity.test.ts (flattened th/en key sets identical, every value non-empty, {param} sets equal per key); translate.test.ts (interpolation string/number/repeated/missing param, blank/missing en -> th + one warn, no warn with dev guard off, unknown key -> key; use casts only in tests); format.test.ts (formatDate(new Date(2026,5,8),'th')==='08/06/2569', en '08/06/2026', time padding, invalid -> '-', money grouping/negative/NaN, ฿ both); labels.test.ts (every known pay id x th/en pinned values, unknown+custom -> label, unknown no label -> id, PAY_ICON covers all known except coupon, ORDER_TYPE_KEYS covers every OrderType); src/store/__tests__/languageStore.test.ts (RN + AsyncStorage mocks; default th, setUiLanguage('en') writes 'pos-language', rehydrate en, garbage -> th, invalid set ignored, non-hook t() follows store); src/i18n/__tests__/useT.test.tsx (React.createElement component, createRoot + act from react-dom/test-utils, IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT=true, re-renders English after setUiLanguage('en')).

No new package in package.json; no forbidden file modified

cd d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\i18n; npm test  (expect new suites green, >=214 + new pass, 3 known suite-load failures)

findings: Commit 0079e9c. Verification: lint = 13 baseline errors (none in touched files); npm test = 259 pass (214 baseline + 45 new: labels 15, translate 10, format 9, parity 4, languageStore 6, useT 1) + the 3 known suite-load failures. Spot-check done: extra key in en/auth.ts -> TS2353, missing key in en/receiptScreen.ts -> TS2741 (reverted). EXPORTS — src/i18n/types.ts: Language, LANGUAGES, isLanguage, LocaleShape, Leaves, TranslationKey, UiKey, ReceiptKey, TParams. src/i18n/translate.ts: translate(lang,key,params?), interpolate, lookup, isDev() (call-time dev guard; tests toggle process.env.NODE_ENV='production'). src/i18n/format.ts: DateInput, formatDate, formatTime, formatDateTime, formatNumber(n,lang,decimals=0), formatMoney. src/i18n/labels.ts: KnownPayMethod, PAY_METHOD_KEYS, PAY_ICON, isKnownPayMethod, payMethodLabel(id,lang,customLabel?), ORDER_TYPE_KEYS, ROLE_KEYS (Record<UserRole,UiKey>, type-only import from store/authStore — erased at runtime), DocTypeId ('receipt'|'tax_short'|'tax_full'), DOC_TYPE_KEYS, DEFAULT_FOOTER_TH, DEFAULT_BRANCH_TH (typed string). src/i18n/useT.ts: useT, t, useUiLanguage, useFormat, bindFormat(lang) -> BoundFormat {date,time,dateTime,number(n,decimals?),money}, types TFunction, BoundFormat — FEAT for useReceiptT can reuse bindFormat(receiptLang) for fmt. src/i18n/index.ts re-exports types, useT module (useT,t,useUiLanguage,useFormat,bindFormat,TFunction,BoundFormat) and labels; NOT format.ts; useReceiptT not yet created (add it to the barrel when created). src/store/languageStore.ts: useLanguageStore, LanguageState (persist 'pos-language' v1; sets document.documentElement.lang). src/components/ui/LanguageToggle.tsx: LanguageToggle, LanguageToggleProps (exported via components/ui/index.ts). KEYS seeded — common: save,cancel,confirm,close,back,loading,error,errorTitle,noData,retry,search, langShort.th|en, docType.receipt|taxShort|taxFull (th ใบเสร็จรับเงิน/ใบกำกับภาษีอย่างย่อ/ใบกำกับภาษี — taxFull matches DocumentCancellationScreen's current 'ใบกำกับภาษี'). nav: logout, role.<UserRole> (snake ids stock_staff/report_viewer kept as keys to match data ids). auth: login,username,password (placeholders; extend). pos: cashierFallback, orderType.<OrderType>. payment: method.{cash,transfer,qr,credit,wallet,ewallet,coupon}, ewalletOther, memberTypeDiscount ('ส่วนลด{name} {percent}%' / '{name} discount {percent}%'). receipt: thankYou, keepReceipt, headOffice, dateTimeValue, cashierFallback, sampleCashier, cancelledStamp (en 'VOID'), docTitle.receipt|taxShort|taxFull, caption.{billNo,date,cashier,paidBy,taxInvoiceNo,issueDate,tel,taxId,posRegNo,buyerInfo,buyerName,buyerAddress,buyerTaxId,branch}, orderDetail.{readyDate,address,phone,note,table,zone}, column.{item,itemService,qty,unitPrice,unitPriceUnit,discount,amount,amountExVat}, subtotal, subtotalInclVat, discount, beforeVat, vat ('ภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่ม {rate}%' / 'VAT {rate}%'), total, totalInclVat, cash, change. receiptScreen: print, share (placeholders; extend). settings: language, uiLanguage, receiptLanguage, receiptLanguageHint. CONVENTIONS: data-id keys mirror the data id (snake allowed, e.g. nav.role.stock_staff); otherwise camelCase; <=3 levels (parity test enforces depth); en files `export const X: LocaleShape<typeof thX>`; new namespace -> register in both th/index.ts and en/index.ts. Test mocks pattern for anything reaching languageStore: vi.mock('react-native') + AsyncStorage as in src/store/__tests__/languageStore.test.ts; useT.test.tsx shows createRoot/act + IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT.
